name: Control Room
description: Control room: who hands work to whom, what waits on you (decision gates answered after a confirm), every agent by product, each product's pull requests and CI, pings of the sites you list, and a full-page Dashboard of keys.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Show a desktop notification once when an agent waits on you or idles past the threshold, or errors, and once when a site you ping goes down or comes back.

settings.title: Repos to watch on the Ship board
settings.description: owner/name, separated by commas. Empty watches every GitHub repo behind your Orca projects.

settings.title: Sites to ping
settings.description: Name=https://url or Product:Name=https://url entries, separated by commas or new lines. A site whose Product is an Orca project shows with that product on Ship. Each is requested once a minute (5 s timeout, no cookies). Empty: no Sites section and no network requests.

settings.title: Allow answering from the panel
settings.description: Decision gates waiting on you get answer buttons in the Queue. Nothing is sent until you confirm. Bot items cannot be answered from the panel; their options open the bot's chat.
